# CEFIPIME

# FOR PERITONITIS ASSOCIATED WITH PERITONEAL DIALYSIS

Cefepime 1 gm PD q24h in 2000 mL 2.5% dextrose diaslyate solution.

[Click Here to order WITH heparin](psjizid-pd-cefepime-1gm-q24h-hep)

If Heparin is contraindicated then:

[Click Here to order WITHOUT heparin](psjizid-pd-cefepime-1gm-q24h)
Inpt: ORZID2 GMENU PD CEFEPIME 1 GM Q24H
